title: Utility of the History and Physical Exam in the Emergency Department
brief_summary: The study is trying to prove that the history and physical exam (H\&P) in the emergency department is the most important tool in exam of patients. The investigator is attempting to correlate the time of the H\&P of residents and attendings to the accuracy of diagnosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Anyone over the age of 18 with a generalized complaints able to provide consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anyone under 18 yrs and anyone with a very specific, system based complaint.
